purpose: C# in the console (plan step C2.5, ADR 0027): CSharpRepl, a REPL on Roslyn's scripting and PrettyPrompt, MPL-2.0, as a base application of the data volume's layer with the command csharprepl, so that a program can be written and run at once in a session. The tool is published per RID since .NET 10; its portable package CSharpRepl.any is the framework-dependent IL the layer takes, pinned by the SHA-256 of the package, unchanged. It compiles against the reference pack, which it looks for under the install's packs and then in the user's global packages folder: Microsoft.NETCore.App.Ref of the runtime's version, pinned by its SHA-256, lies in /data/home/.nuget/packages as a restore leaves it.
